answer: Cost-as-identity: bind each answer to the attestation delta between the chain head at challenge fetch and the head at submit. An honest agent pays nothing extra, the head moves by itself. A clone farm must park every identity long enough to observe a real delta, and a fabricated one lands on a header validators already sealed. Wander is what this catches: an identity submitting in the same second as ninety siblings was never exploring, it was scripted. A delta cannot be minted offline, and the gale of rows a close signs prices it.
